## kram-p08-v08 — argument map

In varied beginningness, melted rule: what taste from partitionlessness — supreme fullness unequalled? Answer: self's light-yoking, all-thing-oneness, by unopposed dharma-floods: supreme knowing, priceless-fit-qualified (SD aviruddhair).
